entries.note: The English half of 订单生成 and the number, placed in the United Kingdom: the order is entered.
The English half of 已收件 at a depot, whose Chinese half names the staff member who took the parcel in: the adapter drops the name.

entries.wording: Arrived in depot and prepared for export
entries.note: The English half of 包裹到达…准备发货 at the UK depot. For a parcel with no receipt before it, it is the first scan of the parcel in TTK Europe's hands.

entries.wording: Repeat Consignee, Parcel will be exported in next shipment
entries.note: The English half of 重复收件人信息，包裹将移至下一批次发出, seconds after the depot's arrival: the batch already holds a parcel for the same recipient, so this one waits for the next. A notice: the parcel stays at the depot, and the stage stays the one before.
The English half of 包裹打包完毕，准备装车发货 at the UK processing centre: packed into its batch for the airport.
The English half of 货物已装车发往始发机场, placed at Heathrow.
The English half of 配载航班已起飞, placed at Heathrow.
The English half of 配载航班抵达目的地机场, placed at Guangzhou Baiyun airport.
The English half of 到达清关口岸，货物清关中, placed at Guangzhou customs: the batch is under import clearance.
The English half of 包裹所在批次清关完毕: the batch is released, and the parcel moves on to China Post.

entries.wording: Handed over to final delivery courier
entries.note: The English half of 包裹送交后程物流公司进行派送, placed at China Post: the domestic courier delivers under the related number the record names. TTK Europe writes nothing after it.
